svg.title: They Were Given White Robes
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 5 panels. Panel 1 (Genesis 3:7, 21): Adam and Eve standing in tunics of hide, the fig-leaf loincloths they had sewn lying on the ground between them. Caption: "Eden. Their fig leaves lie on the ground." Genesis says: "And the LORD God made for Adam and for his wife garments of skins and clothed them." Note: "Skins: an animal died to make them. The study’s reading." Panel 2 (Luke 15:21-22): a son in rags kneeling before his father, who holds out a robe to him. Caption: "Jesus’ picture: the son comes home." The son says: "I am no longer worthy to be called your son." The father says: "Bring quickly the best robe, and put it on him." Panel 3 (Mark 9:2-3): Jesus shining white on a mountain, with Peter, James and John kneeling before Him. Caption: "On the mountain, before Peter, James and John." Mark says: "His clothes became radiant, intensely white, as no one on earth could bleach them." Panel 4 (Revelation 7:9, 13-14): a great crowd in white robes holding palm branches, stretching to the horizon; in front an elder answers John. Caption: "An elder asks John: “Who are these, clothed in white robes?”" An elder says: "They have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb." Note: "Drawn: a few dozen of a multitude no one could number." A strip joins the panels above: λευκαίνω, “make white”: its only two uses in the New Testament. Panel 5 (Revelation 19:7-8): the Bride standing in bright white linen, arms raised, with the saints in white behind her. Caption: "John’s picture: the Bride, made ready." John says: "It was granted her to clothe herself with fine linen, bright and pure." John says: "For the fine linen is the righteous deeds of the saints." Note: "Granted: even the deeds are His gift (Ephesians 2:10)." The point: God puts the white on His people: the robe is washed white in the Lamb’s blood, and even the linen of their righteous deeds is granted. Stand in what He washed (Revelation 7:14; 19:8).
svg.text: Who are these, and where did the white come from?
